summary: Fix is correct, minimal, well-scoped, and matches the bug spec exactly. No security, performance, or architecture issues. Bloat-baseline bump (575->587) honestly justified and consistent with ADR-096. Two low-severity findings raised and both fixed before commit.

review.finding: Sibling helpers (security, run) lacked a dedicated regression test for the non-JSON-stdout stderr-fallback path that finalize_iterate.py's new test covers.
The warn-log JSON field stayed keyed "stderr" even though its value may now be parsed from stdout, misleading a downstream reader about which stream the diagnostic came from.
review.resolution: Renamed the key to "detail" with an inline comment; updated the one test asserting on it (no other consumers found).
